text_block_list.text:
—In that realm, there existed a mighty 
fiend 
known as the "Lord of the Night."

After the dark curtain falls, she emerges 
from the Netherworld. 
With sharp claws and glinting fangs, she 
spirits mortals away.

text_block_list.name: Village Chief
text_block_list.text:
P-Please, stop this! 
Take no more of our villagers...!

text_block_list.name: Village Chief
text_block_list.text:
Whether food or treasure, 
we'll give you whatever you desire...!

text_block_list.name: Village Youth
text_block_list.text:
...Tch, refusing to listen, are you...?!  
Then we take her by force! Let's show her 
the fruits of our training, best friend!

text_block_list.name: Lord of the Night
text_block_list.text: It is futile... Desist.

The Lord of the Night took a single, 
powerful step forward. And then——
(*crunch*)
(*WHOOOOOSH!!*)
(*CRASH CRASH CRASH!!!!*)

A shockwave tore through, whipping up a 
tempest, 
and showering down displaced earth—! 
My friend has... tumbled straight to the 
ground!

text_block_list.name: Lord of the Night
text_block_list.text:
Did I not tell you... it is futile. 
I shall take this one away. ——To the 
Netherworld.

At this rate, my best friend will be 
taken— 
I have to stop her somehow...! 
But what can I do?!
choice_data_list: Shield my best friend with my body...!

text_block_list.text:
Drawing my blade, I dashed forward without 
hesitation. 
The Lord of the Night glanced back——and 
our eyes met.

Why was it—for an instant, 
a subtle flicker of turmoil crossed the 
Lord of the Night's eyes.

—In the end, my strike never landed. 
Before I knew it, I was sprawling clumsily 
on the dirt, 
though I appeared... completely unharmed.

Desperately, I threw myself toward my 
friend. 
From behind, the Lord of the Night's 
presence surged closer—!
choice_data_list:
(She'll kill me...! But I have to protect 
my friend...!)

text_block_list.text:
Why was it—at that moment, 
I heard a voice laced with subtle 
conflict.

No matter how much time passed, pain never 
came. 
For some reason, the Lord of the Night 
refrained from attacking— 
leaving me entirely unscathed.

text_block_list.name: Lord of the Night
text_block_list.text:
——For today's spoils, this one alone will 
suffice.

text_block_list.name: Village Chief
text_block_list.text:
Gah, she took him...! 
Are you all right? Are you hurt?!

text_block_list.name: Village Chief
text_block_list.text:
I see, a blessing in disguise. *sigh*... 
...Back when the Devil Empress ruled over 
us, 
all lived in bliss, and our lands were 
fertile and rich...

text_block_list.name: Ruler, Scion of Darkness
text_block_list.text:
—Well, well, if it isn't the "Lord of the 
Night." 
The terrified cries of mortals echo 
sweetly again tonight.

text_block_list.name: Minion of Darkness Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you performed magnificently today 
as well, didn't you? 
Please, do tell me all the glorious 
details~! 
Lately you've always been going out alone—

text_block_list.name: King of the Night
text_block_list.text:
It was nothing of note. Now, if you will 
excuse me— 
I have matters to attend to tonight.

text_block_list.name: King of the Night
text_block_list.text:
Just a little longer— 
Just a little longer... Empress.

The King of the Night murmured quietly. 
Unheard by anyone, 
the words simply dissolved into the 
darkness...
